title: Career Roadmap · Wireman
summary: A Wireman installs, tests, maintains and repairs electrical wiring, lighting, switches, sockets and distribution circuits in homes, commercial buildings and industrial facilities.

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 8 → ITI Wireman → Practical training / apprenticeship → Wireman → Senior Technician / Electrical Supervisor, subject to applicable authorization.

blocks.label: Entry route
blocks.text: DGT’s Wireman CTS trade lists Class 8 as the entry qualification; confirm current state admission rules.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Science, basic electricity and technical drawing.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Circuits, wiring diagrams, electrical tools and workplace safety.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Measurement, fault identification, careful tool handling and following safety instructions.

items.text: ITI Wireman → Wiring installation, maintenance and repair.
ITI Electrician → Broader electrical installation and equipment maintenance.
Diploma in Electrical Engineering → Further technical study and advanced technician pathways.
Apprenticeship → Supervised workplace experience under an approved training arrangement.

blocks.text: Wireman and Electrician are separate trades with different curricula. A trade certificate does not automatically authorize independent electrical contracting or supervisory work.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Electrical fundamentals, tools, wiring diagrams, measurement and safety.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Domestic wiring, distribution circuits, earthing, testing and fault diagnosis.

blocks.label: Practical training
blocks.text: Install and maintain circuits under qualified supervision.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Lighting circuit board; switch-and-socket layout; earthing demonstration; fault-finding exercise.

blocks.label: Public sector
blocks.text: Railways, electricity utilities and government workshops when vacancies are advertised.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Electrical contractors, factories, building-services firms and facilities-management companies.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Cable routing, installation, testing, maintenance and troubleshooting.
Apply through Apprenticeship India. Availability and selection depend on current vacancies.

blocks.label: Further study
blocks.text: ITI → Eligible diploma or lateral-entry route, where permitted.

items.text: Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
Advanced vocational training in electrical installation and maintenance.
Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS), subject to eligibility.

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Residential wiring, commercial installations, industrial wiring, electrical testing, maintenance and solar electrical systems.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Construction, housing, manufacturing, infrastructure, facilities management and renewable energy.

blocks.label: Technical
blocks.text: Wiring diagrams, cable routing, circuit connections, earthing, testing and fault diagnosis.

blocks.label: Tools
blocks.text: Multimeter, voltage tester, insulation resistance tester, wire strippers, crimpers and approved PPE.

blocks.label: Qualifications
blocks.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized ITI Wireman; apprenticeship completion where applicable; state-specific wireman permit or authorization where required.

blocks.label: Safety
blocks.text: Never work on live circuits without the required authorization, training and approved safe-work procedures.

blocks.label: Countries
blocks.text: Australia, Canada, Germany, UK and New Zealand.

blocks.label: Routes to investigate
blocks.text: TAFE electrical trade programmes; Canadian college / apprenticeship pathways; German dual vocational training; UK electrical installation qualifications; New Zealand approved trade training.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic prerequisites, English or German proficiency where applicable, practical training, apprenticeship requirements and local licensing.
An Indian ITI certificate does not automatically authorize independent electrical work abroad. Verify current entry and licensing requirements.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Wiring Technician, Electrical Installer, Trade Assistant, Maintenance Technician.

items.text: Work authorization and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed; electrical licensing varies by country and region.

blocks.text: ITI Trainee ↓ Apprentice / Junior Wireman ↓ Wireman ↓ Senior Wireman / Specialist ↓ Electrical Supervisor, if eligible ↓ Authorized Contractor / Technical Trainer / Business Owner
